title: Center Stage Musicals
auditions_strip_text: Audition for a Center Stage Musical.
auditions_body: Center Stage musicals cast through open auditions before each production. No experience required — everyone is welcome. See the full list of audition dates and how to sign up.
intro: PYT's largest, professional scale productions, Center Stage Musicals cast actors aged 5-18. Everyone who auditions is cast. Each title has two casts, each cast performs four times - including a weekday matinee performance for schools.
